meetings.description: New meetings transcribe on the hub by default, with Volcengine. This is the same choice as the transcription service in Recording settings.
meetings.title: Use for Meeting Transcription
meetings.x-confirm: New meetings will transcribe on the hub by default: their audio goes to Volcengine as it's recorded, and the hub deletes it once the minutes are written.

read_answers.description: When Persona takes part in a meeting, its answers are read in the voice below. When this is off, or on an error, the phone's own voice reads them.
read_answers.title: Read Answers Aloud

asr_model.description: The model must be turned on in the Doubao Speech console.
asr_model.title: Recognition Model

voice_id.description: A voice ID copied from the voice library (音色库) in the Doubao Speech console; used instead of the voice above.
voice_id.title: Other Voice ID

app_id.description: Only with an App ID and Access Token from the old console: then the API Key field above holds the Access Token.
app_id.title: App ID (Old Console)
